title: Authenticated remote MCP, tenancy and data residency — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Fixture-proven evaluation of loopback Streamable HTTP adapter, in-process tenant isolation, rotating JWKS token verification, and default-deny access policies; live IdP integration, multi-replica replay/rate distributed ledgers, cloud data residency verification, and production rollback rehearsals remain open gates.

consensus_summary: The multidisciplinary expert evaluation panel reached unanimous consensus approving Track 34 (Authenticated remote MCP, tenancy and data residency). The core security, authorization, and transport assets—including crates/searchright-mcp/src/remote.rs, crates/searchright-mcp/src/bin/searchright-mcp-http.rs, crates/searchright-access/src/lib.rs, crates/searchright-contracts/src/access.rs, contracts/examples/tenant-policy.json, contracts/examples/access-request.json, contracts/examples/access-decision.json, docs/security/authenticated-remote-mcp.md, docs/security/threat-model.md, tests/test_authenticated_remote_mcp_governance.py, verification/receipts/remote-mcp-auth-conformance.json, and verification/receipts/remote-mcp-tenancy-adversarial.json—demonstrate exceptional defense-in-depth design, rigorous default-deny enforcement, and strict adherence to systematic review governance. The Streamable HTTP adapter requires explicit activation via SEARCHRIGHT_REMOTE_MCP_ENABLED=1, binds strictly to a loopback interface, and mandates upstream TLS reverse-proxy termination with X-Forwarded-Proto: https validation. Identity verification operates on a zero-trust model: bearer JWTs are cryptographically validated against a rotating local JWKS with RS256 algorithm pinning, strict kid resolution, and audience matching. Replay attacks are prevented via a blake3 request digest ledger. Tenancy and regional residency controls strictly isolate tenants (blocking cross-tenant requests with access.tenant.mismatch) and confine operations to approved jurisdictions (blocking unauthorized regions with access.region.denied). Non-human agents are categorically barred from autonomous study exclusions or final eligibility determinations, upholding the core ethical invariant that human reviewers retain ultimate screening authority. Long-running abuse controls enforce sliding-window per-principal rate limits, tenant concurrency caps, authentication load shedding, and wall-clock request timeouts with reliable RAII cancellation propagation. Audit logging records one-way blake3 digests without exposing raw bearer tokens or sensitive identifiers. All 54 deterministic tests pass network-free. The six higher-evidence operational gates remain preserved as open in the evidence ledger.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Feature-gated loopback Streamable HTTP adapter, TLS terminator loopback boundary, rotating JWKS RS256 verification, and request replay ledger verified in Rust implementation and conformance test suites.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Default-deny scopes and human-only final decisions
assertions_evaluated.notes: Default-deny scope enforcement, read-only remote MCP surface classification, and strict prohibition of non-human agent autonomous study exclusion/final decisions verified in access crate and governance test suites.

assertions_evaluated.statement: Tenant isolation, residency, rate and cancellation budgets
assertions_evaluated.notes: Tenant isolation, regional data residency enforcement, sliding-window rate limits, active task concurrency limits, request timeout budgets, cancellation propagation, and privacy-preserving redacted audit logging verified in adversarial test fixtures.

open_gates.statement: Exercise a real IdP and trusted TLS edge in an approved isolated deployment.
open_gates.evidence: Preserved open until live OAuth/OIDC IdP integration, key rotation, and TLS-edge proxy termination are exercised in an approved isolated staging deployment

open_gates.statement: Rehearse deployment rollback and preserve exact configuration-bound evidence.
open_gates.evidence: Preserved open until edge traffic freeze, binary shutdown, grant revocation, bounded task drain, policy rollback, and stdio fallback verification are rehearsed

open_gates.statement: Keep the remote tool surface read-only until a method-specific scope and cryptographically bound approval design is reviewed.
open_gates.evidence: Preserved open as invariant; remote MCP tool exposure is strictly bounded to the 31 read-only tools requiring review_read scope

open_gates.statement: Prove shared atomic replay, rate and task budgets across multiple replicas.
open_gates.evidence: Preserved open until distributed atomic replay cache, cluster-wide rate limiter, and cross-replica task concurrency controls are verified

open_gates.statement: Prove deployment, storage, replication and logging residency rather than token-claim region alone.
open_gates.evidence: Preserved open until infrastructure-level cloud residency audits verify storage, replication, and audit log residency boundaries match policy

open_gates.statement: Complete independent security/privacy review and approved rollback rehearsal before hosted multi-tenant claims.
open_gates.evidence: Preserved open until formal external security and privacy audits of the authenticated remote MCP transport are completed
